title: The Big Nap
cover: A big sun over a garden, Pip and Tip small below. Big, simple and friendly.

pages.beat: A big sun over a garden, Pip and Tip small below.
Pip lying in the shade of a shed doorway.
Mim in front of a small fan, fur blowing.
Jack jumping into the pond, big splash.

pages.text: Jack is wet. Spot is wet.
pages.beat: Both dripping at the pond edge.

pages.text: Dusk. The sun is not hot.
pages.beat: Low sun, lavender sky, the garden.

pages.text: All sat. Sam, Bob, Chip, Spot, Jack, Max, Zip and Pip.
pages.beat: Eight dogs in a row on the grass.
Sam, Bob, Spot and Jack lying still on the grass, Tip and Mim curled among them.

pages.text: Tip is on Sam. Mim is on Bob. Pip is on the rug.
pages.beat: The cats asleep on the dogs.

pages.text: Nap, all. Nap in the dusk.
pages.beat: Sam, Bob, Chip, Spot, Jack, Max, Zip, Pip, Tip and Mim all asleep together on the grass at dusk.

framing: Composition: the plain cream background fills the whole frame edge to edge with no border, frame line, margin or vignette.
